seed_nodes.note: The team's PC, the first node of the testnet. Serverless: reachable over Tor v3 onion (no open port) and over iroh (QUIC + n0 hole-punching) for snapshot and tail-sync. Same onion and iroh identity it had on Zenith, now on the testnet's own port.

notes: Zoka Quantic testnet: Ironwood (Halo 2, no trusted setup) with X-Wing note encryption from its first block. Test coins with no value.
Genesis: block 1 1d204e8116f53d74302db20b943b288d141681a9be463f65a43861dd47c2d242, created 2026-10-22 11:16 UTC. The team's PC is the first seed.
Zoka has two networks, Zoka Quantic Testnet and Zoka Quantic Mainnet. This testnet restarts from zero, with new addresses, when the fully post-quantum private pool is ready.
It never mixes with other networks: it announces its own protocol id, uses its own gossip topics and listens on P2P port 28180 by default.
